text:
maria-sales: Hey team — HealthCorp (J. Lee) asked for a quick summary of routing & subprocessor constraints for their clinical-data POC. They want: 1) a list of sub-processors we use in EU & APAC, 2) confirmation that control/data plane signaling can remain in EU (no user payload egress), 3) pricing delta for dedicated capacity in eu-west vs apac-southeast, 4) BYO-KMS feasibility. They've attached a redacted security questionnaire.

j.lee (HealthCorp): +1. Timing: they want answers by EOD Wednesday. Also ask if we can add a network ACL to restrict outbound IPs to their VPC.

sam-solutions: Quick answers: we can provide subproc list (SOC2 + DPAs). Control plane signaling (heartbeats/metrics) currently crosses regions if using hosted control plane — but Private (VPC) keeps it local. For hosted dedicated, we can route inference traffic to eu-west and apac, but control plane may be in us-east by default. :eyes: 

leo-eng: More detail from runtime side: inference data stays in the model region when you pin model & tenant. We have two common knobs:
- region_pin: forces inference compute to prefer region
- controlplane_local: only available in Private (VPC/onprem)

Example config snippet they can use:
```
routes:
  tenant_affinity: eu-west-1
  fallback: apac-southeast-1
  allow_controlplane_cross_region: false
```

maria-sales: Leo — can we support "allow_controlplane_cross_region: false" for a Dedicated contract (reserved capacity) or only for Private?

leo-eng: Dedicated: control plane still runs in our control plane (hosted) -> not guaranteed. Private: yes. For Dedicated we can do a mitigated approach: control plane metadata (no PII) might traverse regions, but payloads (prompts/responses) stay;

anika-legal: From a compliance standpoint: we can supply subprocessor list and sign a DPA with EU SCCs. BYO-KMS: supported in Private & Dedicated with contractual KMS routing. For Hosted, BYO-KMS is limited (we do envelope encryption but master key not customer-managed). For network ACLs: in Dedicated we can add egress IP allowlist for customer peering/contact. Need SSO and network contacts for handoff.

infra-bot: Deploy ticket created: #DEP-4821. Assigned to eng-platform. ETA for Dedicated routing docs: 48h.

sam-solutions: Pricing note: dedicated capacity delta: eu-west ~ +18% vs standard us price; apac-southeast ~ +30% (GPU availability + networking). These are ballparks — need quote from finance for exact numbers. I'll open a sales quote.

maria-sales: J. Lee — we'll get subproc list + written control plane explanation + quote by Wed EOD. Can you share the redacted questionnaire link again? Also who is the technical contact at HealthCorp for peering?

j.lee (HealthCorp): Thanks. Questionnaire link: https://hcorp.s3/secure/q1-redacted.pdf. Technical contact: aaron.kim@healthcorp.com. I'll loop him in once you confirm timeline.

anika-legal: Also flag: HealthCorp asked about certification for APAC subprocessors — we only have SOC2 for primary infra; some third-party CDNs in APAC may not be SOC2. We'll call out variations in the subproc list.

leo-eng: Action items for eng: 1) export subproc inventory (EU, APAC) 2) doc control-plane behavior for Dedicated vs Private 3) sample ACL/peering steps. I'll push a draft into the ticket.

maria-sales: Excellent. Sam — please start the finance quote and ping @infra-bot for runtime docs. Anika — can you prepare DPA + BYO-KMS contract blurb?

anika-legal: On it. Will try to reuse standard clause and annotate BYO-KMS limitations.

maria-sales: Thanks — we'll update HealthCorp once we have the artifacts. :thumbsup:
